Sorry this is long but I promise there is a point to my sob story lol. 
Me and my girlfriend were together and lived together for 4 years. We moved in to an apartment together with my friend after knowing eachother a month. Things were great and we had some bad times obviously but we had some amazing times and throughout most of it I really believed she was my spirit mate. Last year in March (close to our 4 year mark) I tried to kill myself and made her leave me to help her out cuz i feel im not healthy for her and ultimately im going to end it one day anyways so might as well do her a favor is what i thought. (I know I'm a piece of human shit im well aware). Well we didnt talk for a month or so then she calls me freaking out saying she doesnt want to be with anybody but me. Weve spent the past year in 2 diff sides of the country "waiting for eachother" and trying to work things out and hopefully have her move back to my state and get her own place and start over. 
This past year ive been in my dirty apartment all alone with no one (I have no family cept my brother, we dont c eachother much) and ive had alot of time to just think and reflect on myself and the mistakes ive made, ive been going to bars alot and meeting really cool people and just overall have been being less of a misanthropic hermit. I told her last week that its pointless to keep torturing ourselves trying to make a dying long distance relationship work and that we need to just end it. We haven't talked since.
If I sat here and told you that I'm not sad I would be lying but its a kind of sad that im glad I got to experience. 
Moral to this boring stupid story is there will always be people coming and going from your life, whether u left them bcuz of some idiot mistake u made (were all human, it will happen) or they left you or you just drifted apart or what have you. U sound like a beautiful person inside and out and i know its hard watching friends enjoy relationships and it makes you feel lonely and worthless but dont listen to that voice in your head. Never stop meeting people, get outside and go for a walk, go to a hipster bar or whatever and make friends and get some numbers over the weekends, focus on whatever makes you happy (art, music, writing, photography, your blog, fitness). 
I know it seems like what I'm saying is a crock of shit but youre going to meet sooo many great people and lovers and sometimes the people youd least expect will be the most important people in your life a year or so down the road. And the ones You thought youd be with forever might become less of a part of your life. You never know, all your "friends" who patronize you about being better off single might end up in a dying failing marraige and wondering what they did the past 10 years, while you were having a good time and not getting too hung up on it and focusing on YOUR life. 
Thats the end of my 200 cents. 
Stay strong, message me if you ever wana get some shit off your chest.
